old_fields.claim_text: Drop-2 voicings lower the second voice from the top of a close-position four-note seventh chord by one octave into the left hand or lower register.
old_fields.falsification_or_boundary_condition: Drop-2 requires four-voice tertian chords; does not apply to triads or five-note voicings.

new_fields.citation_reference: John Thomas, Voice Leading for Guitar, Drop-2 Voicings, Figure 18, https://online.berklee.edu/takenote/voice-leading-for-guitar/. Historical Levine (1995), Ch.17, p.280 remains unverified.
new_fields.claim_text: For the specified four-note close-position example, drop-2 lowers the second voice from the top by one octave. The transformation determines register, not a compulsory left-hand assignment.
new_fields.falsification_or_boundary_condition: This STEPS example is four-note. It does not establish a prohibition on applying a drop operation to other voice counts; hand distribution and playability require separate choices.
